top_choice_rationale: Palladium-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling by Buchwald and Hartwig is the one proposal whose maturity, chemical identity and credit allocation I can check against the record without a caveat: ligand-controlled, mechanistically established with isolated intermediates, confirmed by three decades of independent use, and distinct from the 2010 C-C coupling prize if the citation says carbon-nitrogen. P001 is a strong second because the ternary-complex mechanism is quantitative and approved cereblon glues validate the principle, but the Crews/Deshaies/Handa cut omits structural contributors such as Ciulli whose ligase-degrader-target structures made the PROTAC arm rationally designable. Both are preferable to no award.
